strips.title: A Tuesday with the Dreame X50 Ultra

panels.head: 8:00 AM — you leave
panels.text: The schedule starts it after the door closes. Its legs lift it over the sill into the next room.

panels.head: It sees the sock
panels.text: Camera + AI steer around socks and clutter. Keep short cords off the floor: TechRadar saw it miss short wires.

panels.head: Under the sofa: 3.5 inches
panels.text: The LiDAR turret lowers, so it fits under a sofa gap a 3.8-inch robot can't.

panels.head: Home: it washes its mop
panels.text: The dock empties the bin and washes and dries the pads with hot water.
